items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Yeah, I just, Piero Giffen was the ball. ... [INTERVIEWEE] And Florida Street Snooki.

You're gonna get good then! Ha ha ha! True! Well done! . . . Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, they were real high on that. They were real high. Way behind me. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. . Could you give me some names of piano players from Memphis?
Yeah, I just, Piero Giffen was the ball. Yeah. And James Bailey, Strukson, Albert Van Hust.
